children: shares fell 12.11% in premarket after reports that the chipmaker is in advanced talks to buy optical components maker Lumentum Holdings
, with a deal possibly announced as soon as next week, Reuters reported, citing a source familiar with the matter. Lumentum shares rose 6.43%.

Lumentum, whose components move data through communications networks and AI data centers, has a market value of about $83 billion. Marvell had about $3.92 billion in cash and equivalents as of its latest quarter, and Bernstein analysts said a deal of that size would likely require additional financing and could bring integration challenges. Neither company immediately responded to requests for comment.

A deal would extend Marvell's push into optical technology for AI infrastructure, following its $3.25 billion acquisition of photonics firm Celestial AI, announced late last year. Marvell, whose shares have nearly tripled this year, raised its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast earlier this month to $20 billion from $15 billion.

title: Marvell Bets Bigger on AI Optics With Lumentum Talks
